name: Circum Icons
about: Circum Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 288 icons designed by Klarr Agency. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Mozilla Public License 2.0.

faqs.q: Are Circum Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 288 Circum Icons are open source under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the Mozilla Public License 2.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Circum Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Circum Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 288 icons in the Circum Icons set, designed by Klarr Agency. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Circum Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Circum Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
